doc: 2D spatial-bucketed sprite/entry pool (0x40 bytes, allocated at GfxSceneSprite+0x5C in 0x002E6B14 and initialized by Save_SlotTable_Init 0x005F1F08). Manages a fixed-capacity pool of 0x70-byte entries with a 32-bit occupancy bitmask (+0x10..+0x20) and a secondary array of 0x88-byte spatial buckets with a scratch query bitmask (+0x00..+0x0C, +0x24..+0x38) and sequence counter (+0x3C).

fields.name: bucketAllocator
fields.doc: Allocator interface pointer (vtable[+0x0C] alloc, vtable[+0x14] free) for the spatial bucket and scratch query-bitmap buffer (stored in 0x005F1F08, invoked in Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntries 0x002E61F4).

fields.name: bucketBuffer
fields.doc: Base pointer to the combined allocation holding the scratch query bitmask followed by the 0x88-byte bucket array (allocated in 0x005F1F08, null-checked in 0x005F1AF8/0x005F22E4/0x005F24A4, freed in 0x002E61F4).

fields.name: queryBitmapBytes
fields.doc: 16-byte aligned byte size (((bitmapWordCount * 8) + 0xF) & ~0xF) reserved at the start of bucketBuffer for the scratch query bitmask (computed and zeroed via 0x001113EC in 0x005F1F08).

fields.name: entryAllocator
fields.doc: Allocator interface pointer (vtable[+0x0C] alloc, vtable[+0x14] free) for the 0x70-byte entry pool and occupancy bitmask buffer (stored in 0x005F1F08, invoked in 0x002E61F4).

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: Pointer to the contiguous array of entryCapacity 0x70-byte pool entries (allocated and initialized in 0x005F1F08; indexed by idx * 0x70 in 0x005F1AF8, 0x005F22E4, 0x005F24A4, and 0x002E61F4).

fields.name: occupancyBitmap
fields.doc: Pointer to the 32-bit occupancy bitmask array immediately following entries (entries + entryCapacity * 0x70); scanned for a free bit in Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc (0x005F24A4) and cleared on release in Svc_HandlePool_Release (0x005F1AF8).

fields.name: entryCapacity
fields.doc: Total capacity of the 0x70-byte entry pool (stored in 0x005F1F08; bounds-checked in 0x002E61F4, 0x005F1AF8, and 0x005F24A4).

fields.name: usedEntryCount
fields.doc: Number of currently allocated 0x70-byte entries in the pool (zeroed in 0x005F1F08, incremented in Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc 0x005F24A4, decremented in Svc_HandlePool_Release 0x005F1AF8).

fields.name: bucketCount
fields.doc: Number of 0x88-byte spatial buckets in buckets (set to slotCount in 0x005F1F08; bounds-checked against bucket index in 0x005F21C0, 0x005F22E4, and 0x005F24A4).

fields.name: buckets
fields.doc: Pointer to the array of bucketCount 0x88-byte spatial bucket records at bucketBuffer + queryBitmapBytes (initialized in 0x005F1F08; indexed by slot * 0x88 in 0x005F1AF8, 0x005F21CC, 0x005F22E4, and 0x005F24A4).

fields.name: maxEntries
fields.doc: Copy of entryCapacity stored for the bucket table in Save_SlotTable_Init (0x005F1F08: table[0xb] = entryCount).

fields.name: activeBucketEntryCount
fields.doc: Number of active entries currently registered in spatial buckets (zeroed in 0x005F1F08, incremented in Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc 0x005F24A4, decremented in Svc_HandlePool_Release 0x005F1AF8).

fields.name: bitmapWordCount
fields.doc: Number of 32-bit words ((entryCapacity + 31) >> 5) in occupancyBitmap and queryBitmap (computed in 0x005F1F08; used to clear and scan queryBitmap in 0x005F1C54 and Field_CollectIdsInRect 0x005F22E4).

fields.name: queryBitmap
fields.doc: Pointer to the scratch query bitmask at the start of bucketBuffer; zeroed and populated with matching entry bits during rect queries in 0x005F1C54 and scanned in Field_CollectIdsInRect (0x005F22E4).

doc: Save-slot UI row controller (0x330 = 816 bytes per row; vtable 0x00780B20, constructed by Save_SlotUi_Ctor 0x0045E6A0, reset by Save_SlotEntry_Reset 0x002A5458, pane-bound by 0x0045DBD8, populated by Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry 0x0045DCF8). Also includes outer 3-slot window offsets (+0x50, +0x380, +0x6B0) from Save_SlotUi_BuildThree (0x0045D980), where a 0x9E0-byte window embeds three 0x330-byte SaveSlotUi rows.

fields.name: vtable
fields.doc: Polymorphic vtable pointer (set to 0x00780B20 in Save_SlotUi_Ctor 0x0045E6A0 after base 0x0075E6C8; restored to 0x0075E6C8 in dtor 0x0045E700).

fields.name: slotHeaderHigh
fields.doc: Upper 32-bit word of the 64-bit save-slot header value at +0x08..+0x0F copied via ldrd/strd from slotData[0..1] in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8) and zeroed in Save_SlotEntry_Reset (0x002A5458).

fields.name: slotIndex
fields.doc: Zero-based save slot index (0..2 in Save_SlotUi_BuildThree, 3 in Ui_TitlePagerWindow_SetupRows; reset to 0xFF in Save_SlotEntry_Reset 0x002A5458 and formatted as slotIndex + 1 in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry 0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: summaryStringVtable
fields.doc: Vtable pointer (0x007825A8) of the first embedded 0x104-byte fixed wide-string object (+0x14..+0x117), initialized in Save_SlotUi_Ctor (0x0045E6A0).

fields.name: summaryTextBuffer
fields.doc: Start of the first 128-wchar_t buffer (+0x18..+0x117) holding the formatted single-line slot summary (slot number, hero name, title, Lv, level); zeroed in 0x0045E6A0/0x002A5458 and appended via std_wcsncat in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: outerSlotRow0
fields.doc: Outer 3-slot window offset +0x50: first embedded 0x330-byte SaveSlotUi instance inside the 0x9E0-byte save-slot list window, passed to Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry(self + 0x50, ..., 0, -1) in Save_SlotUi_BuildThree (0x0045D980).

fields.name: locationTimeStringVtable
fields.doc: Vtable pointer (0x007825A8) of the second embedded 0x104-byte fixed wide-string object (+0x118..+0x21B), initialized in Save_SlotUi_Ctor (0x0045E6A0).

fields.name: locationTimeTextBuffer
fields.doc: Start of the second 128-wchar_t buffer (+0x11C..+0x21B) holding the formatted save location name (slotData + 0x1C) and play time (hours:minutes); cleared in 0x0045E6A0/0x002A5458 and populated in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: headerTimeStringVtable
fields.doc: Vtable pointer (0x007825A8) of the third embedded 0x104-byte fixed wide-string object (+0x21C..+0x31F), initialized in Save_SlotUi_Ctor (0x0045E6A0).

fields.name: headerTimeTextBuffer
fields.doc: Start of the third 128-wchar_t buffer (+0x220..+0x31F) holding the formatted slot number, hero name, title, and play time; cleared in 0x0045E6A0/0x002A5458 and populated in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: ownerWindow
fields.doc: Pointer to the owning UI window/layout stored by maybe_Ui_TenRowModePanes_Setup (0x0045DBD8), zeroed in Save_SlotUi_Ctor (0x0045E6A0), and passed to Ui_TextLayer_SetText in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: paneGroupMode
fields.doc: Pane group selector (1, 2, or 3) set in maybe_Ui_TenRowModePanes_Setup (0x0045DBD8) and read in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8) and 0x0045E64C to select one of the three 10-pane layout tables (0x0072D464, 0x0072D4B4, 0x0072D504).

fields.name: markIconPane
fields.doc: Pointer to the 11th BFLYT pane (nw::lyt::Pane*) resolved via FindPaneByName in maybe_Ui_TenRowModePanes_Setup (0x0045DBD8), zeroed in 0x0045E6A0, and visibility-toggled (pane->u8_44 bit 0) from slotData->u8_9C in Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry (0x0045DCF8).

fields.name: outerSlotRow1
fields.doc: Outer 3-slot window offset +0x380 (0x50 + 0x330): second embedded 0x330-byte SaveSlotUi instance inside the 0x9E0-byte save-slot list window, passed to Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry(self + 0x380, ..., 1, -1) in Save_SlotUi_BuildThree (0x0045D980).

fields.name: outerSlotRow2
fields.doc: Outer 3-slot window offset +0x6B0 (0x50 + 2 * 0x330): third embedded 0x330-byte SaveSlotUi instance inside the 0x9E0-byte save-slot list window, passed to Save_SlotUi_BuildEntry(self + 0x6b0, ..., 2, -1) in Save_SlotUi_BuildThree (0x0045D980).

doc: NintendoWare nw::lyt::Pane layout node (constructed by Ui_LayoutPane_InitFromRes 0x005387EC with vtable 0x00781348). Formerly misnamed Save_CryptoKey before R_044 refined 0x005F1A38 to Save_Config_ApplyParamToTree, which sets the 4 corner vertex colors via vtable[+0x10] and recursively walks the intrusive child pane list at +0x14.

fields.name: childListHead
fields.doc: Head pointer of the intrusive doubly-linked child pane list (nw::ut::LinkList<nw::lyt::Pane> at +0x14..+0x1B, where each child link node is at child + 0x04); initialized in Ui_LayoutPane_InitFromRes (0x005387EC) and walked in 0x005F1A38 and Ui_LayoutPane_FindByName (0x005383F4).

fields.name: maybe_vtableSlot10Artifact
fields.doc: Extractor artifact from (**(code **)(*param_1 + 0x10))(param_1, corner, &color) in 0x005F1A38 where +0x10 on int* param_1 was scaled to byte offset 0x40; on an actual nw::lyt::Pane instance (0x005387EC), offset +0x40 holds the pane height float (size.height).

doc: UI layout wrapper object (Ui_Object, constructed by Ui_Object_CtorBase 0x001A66A0 with vtable 0x007593A4) whose methods Save_Config_ApplyRootParam (0x001A6360, vtable[+0x4C]) and Save_Config_ApplyNodeParam (0x001A6164) propagate vertex-color modulation to its bound nw::lyt::Pane hierarchy at +0x30 via 0x005F1A38.

fields.name: rootPane
fields.doc: Pointer to the root nw::lyt::Pane (SaveCryptoKey*) of this UI object; queried by pane name via vtable[+0x2C] (Ui_LayoutPane_FindByName 0x005383F4) in Save_Config_ApplyNodeParam (0x001A6164) and passed directly to 0x005F1A38 in Save_Config_ApplyRootParam (0x001A6360).
